items.claim: LinkedCursor and TrialOverview crosshairs flip y one time too many under `yAxis: 'up'`
`clampZoomAbout` rescales a pan about the top-left corner when the view sits outside a narrowed zoom range
CanvasStack reads the top window's `devicePixelRatio`, not the element's own window's
An inline `worldSpec` redraws every CanvasStack layer on each parent render
A two-finger pan stops dead at the zoom bound, because `clampZoomAbout` reads the pinch's pan as part of its zoom
items.note: The pinch now clamps to the camera's live `zoomRange()` itself, about the old centroid and before it pans.

items.claim: Raising `minZoom` or lowering `maxZoom` makes the next pan jump the zoom about the top-left corner
In `packages/ui`, `SpanStrip.module.css` had a raw-px `font-size` that fails `check-design-tokens`, so `lint -w @weasel-js/labkit` failed at the frozen commit
In `apps/draw`, `Treemap.module.css` had a bare `font-variant-numeric` that fails `check:numeric` at the frozen commit

items.note: Not fixed, outside this area: core's `watchDevicePixelRatio` watches only the global window, so a stack in an iframe still won't hear that frame's density change. Fixing it means adding a window parameter to core.
